reuse.why: Consolidates the three copied category queries into one getBudgetableCategories and reuses setNMonthAvg, though copyPreviousMonth keeps its own path instead of using the new selection.

duplication.why: Removes the triplicated SQL and income checks, but the skip rule is still expressed twice: in getBudgetableCategories' SQL/filter and in copyPreviousMonth's hidden/group_hidden/hasSavedTemplates checks.

placement.why: Selection and template detection live as private helpers next to the month-wide actions in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Focused on month-wide actions; the setAllNMonthAvg consolidation goes slightly beyond the request but is directly related.

maintainability.why: A single selection function is easy to own; the second rule path in copyPreviousMonth and the defensive JSON parse that treats bad JSON as 'has templates' are minor wrinkles.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth decides hidden/group-hidden/template skipping itself on getBudgetData rows rather than through getBudgetableCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The skip rule appears as SQL WHERE plus filter in getBudgetableCategories and as per-row early returns in copyPreviousMonth, the same rule in two shapes.

one_place.where: getBudgetableCategories serves setZero/set3MonthAvg/set6/12MonthAvg, but copyPreviousMonth applies the hidden and template rules with its own checks (only hasSavedTemplates is shared).
